baseline: Mean predictions of the three frozen physical GraphWM checkpoints. Lowest predicted wait, ties prefer abstention.
features: Four-particle filtered public state and frozen physical model action-effect estimates. Only simulator outcomes in training labels.
targets: Paired wait and uncovered care minutes for cleaning and transport relative to abstention.
regression: Standardized ridge with alpha in [1,10,100], chosen by DEV mean absolute error scaled by TRAIN mean absolute effects. Independent equations for all outputs.
policy: Minimize predicted waiting among actions with predicted uncovered care change <=0 relative to abstention. Ties prefer abstention. Equal budget cap 16 staff-hours.
primary: 24h paired outcome difference versus frozen physical ensemble. Require upper 95% structure-bootstrap limits below zero for wait and <=0 for uncovered care, and budget respected.
secondary: 6/12h, zero-effect reference, wait-only ablation, realized spending and comparison at fixed expenditure (cleaning vs transport).
